text:
maria: FYI partner-team asked for full request+response audit logs for debugging sensitive billing issues. they want raw text for a small set of tenants.
kevin: we should avoid storing raw responses by default. opt-in audit logs + strict per-tenant controls sounds OK. need privacy-safe approach.
ash: (typo: meant ash) how small is small? 2 tenants or 200?
maria: two pilots, but likely expand if it works.
ash (ash): got it. proposal: per-tenant HMAC for PII tokens + store HMACs instead of plaintext. allows dedupe and linkbacks w/o exposing content. key stored in KMS per-tenant.
samir: HMAC makes sense. need to discuss rotation: when salt/keys rotate HMACs break linkage — can we version keys and keep lookup table for last N keys?
kevin: yes keep key versions, but limit retention window. also fallback behavior when KMS unavailable is critical.
elaine: UX ask: console should show a per-route "retain logs %" slider and an "inspect TTL" (ephemeral access window). quick mock:
```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "retain_pct": 5,
  "pii_handling": "hmac",
  "hmac_key_ref": "kms://tenant/123/key",
  "inspect_ttl_sec": 3600
}
```
maria: that looks good. also need a one-click "grant inspect token" flow which emits an audit event and expiry. support team will request these tokens.
kevin: security note: inspect tokens must be short-lived, tied to operator identity, and recorded in audit trail. consider mandatory just-in-time 2FA for generating.
ash (ash): ops-bot could post generation event to the tenant's audit log channel.
ops-bot: config update pushed to staging for route /v1/generate (reacted :white_check_mark:)
samir: another policy question: sampling vs retention. if we set retain_pct low, we'll miss anomalies (regressions). can we make sampling quota-aware: increase retention when traffic drops below commit to preserve historical examples?
kevin: idea: sampling_score = min(1, (target_volume / current_volume) * base_rate). if current volume << target, bump retention to keep enough traces for model quality checks.
elaine: console could display an "adaptive sampling" toggle with preview of expected retention curve.
ash (ash): also we need a privacy fallback when KMS is unreachable: remove all entities (NER-based redact) and tag record with "pii_masked_kms_down". must alert SRE.
maria: agree. action items:
- ash: draft HMAC key lifecycle + KMS fallback doc (eta Tue)
- samir: prototype quota-aware sampling equation + telemetry sim (eta Wed)
- elaine: mock console UX for per-route retain slider + adaptive toggle (eta Fri)
- kevin: design inspect token lifecycle + extra 2FA requirement (eta Thu)
kevin: small note re: telemetry pipeline: sampled HMACs still allow counting distinct users only if we keep deterministic HMAC window. we should document retention/rotation tradeoffs.
samir: small log example for audit event so infra/telemetry can parse:
```
2026-03-19T15:22:10Z tenant=123 route=/v1/generate action=inspect_token_create actor=elaine token_id=tok_01 expiry=2026-03-19T16:22:10Z method=just_in_time_2fa
```
elaine: ok i've scheduled a quick sync tomorrow to align UX and privacy wording.
maria: thanks all — keep thread updated. if anyone wants to pair on the HMAC snippet ping me.
kevin: +1. prefer HMAC over storing any plaintext. small PR to proto ledger later.
ops-bot: staging tests for hmac-path passed (reacted :tada:)
_note: Slack thread messages are in chronological order; messages are short and include code blocks and bot notices.
